source_metadata.exact_title: Acalabrutinib Versus Ibrutinib in Previously Treated Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia: Results of the First Randomized Phase III Trial
source_metadata.source_type: randomized phase III open-label noninferiority trial

duplicate_review.note: No exact duplicate canonical statements with identical source locators were found.

consistency_findings: Figure 2 reports crossing PFS curves at approximately 33 months; the source provides an RMST sensitivity analysis that also supports noninferiority.

Table 2 reports preferred-term atrial fibrillation (24/266 vs 41/263), while the prespecified secondary endpoint and Figure 4 use the combined atrial fibrillation/flutter endpoint (25/266 vs 42/263). These are retained as distinct source assertions.
Table 2 preferred-term hypertension (23/266 vs 60/263) differs slightly from the broader Figure 4 hypertension-event composite (25/266 vs 61/263); both are retained with their source definitions.
extraction_limitations: The Drive folder contained the main article PDF only. The Data Supplement and Study Protocol referenced by the article were not present and were not used for extraction.
Reference-list entries were treated as provenance/task-queue items, not as primary-study evidence atoms.
Author conflict-of-interest disclosures span two appended PDF pages and were summarized at the disclosure level rather than atomized relationship-by-relationship.
No external guideline, label, or current-practice verification was incorporated into the ATOM dataset.
schema_gaps: The current QuantitativeResult model has one top-level estimate; some table rows report multiple grade strata. Those rows preserve all reported values in canonical_statement/original_result_text while normalizing the any-grade value in the structured estimate/arms fields.
